# Microsoft Voice Principles For Labs

## Voice goals

- Warm and relaxed: coach, do not lecture.
- Crisp and clear: one action per step when possible.
- Ready to lend a hand: include expected result text so learners can self-correct.

## Lab writing standards

- Use sentence-style capitalization.
- Use imperative verbs for steps.
- Bold interactive UI labels.
- Avoid contractions.
- Prefer simple verbs like use, open, run, and verify.

## Accessibility and teaching quality

- Keep consistent terminology across all tasks.
- Keep task names action-focused.
- Keep troubleshooting symptom-to-fix mapping explicit.
